sources.quote: 8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
4. Finish: anodise type II, thickness 10 to 15 micrometres, black, per specification SPEC-FIN-12.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR. Drawing Rev C, the revision in force, specifies anodise type II as the finish. Changing it to chromate conversion coat is a change to a drawing requirement, so written Stellantis approval is needed before implementation. The documents contain no such approval.
